SELECT pl.purchase_number AS purchaseNumber, pl.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, s.id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, plg.name AS goodsName, plg.code AS code, plg.model AS model, plg.num AS num, plg.price AS price, plg.total AS total FROM "t_purchase_list" pl LEFT JOIN "t_supplier" s ON pl.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN "t_purchase_list_goods" plg ON pl.id = plg.purchase_list_id WHERE pl.is_del = 0
AND pl.supplier_id = #{query.supplierId}
AND pl.purchase_date >= TO_DATE(#{query.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND pl.purchase_date <= TO_DATE(#{query.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND plg.name LIKE '%' || #{query.goodsName} || '%'
ORDER BY pl.purchase_date DESC
